newsitem.title: USA: Scientific Games sees Q2 meeting expectations.
newsitem.headline: Scientific Games sees Q2 meeting expectations.

text.p: Scientific Games Holdings Corp said Thursday that it expects to meet Wall Street expectations for second quarter earnings per share prior to taking two one-time write-offs.
The consensus analyst estimate for Scientific Games' second quarter is $0.46 per share, according to First Call.
Scientific Games said earnings per share prior to the write-offs as well as revenues for the quarter are expected to be a record for the company.

As previously announced, Scientific Games will recognize a one-time, non-cash write-off of $10.1 million for in-process technology related to the April 15 acquisition of Tele Control, an Austrian subsidiary. This write-off is an accounting practice related to technology-based acquisitions.
Scientific Games further announced its decision to discontinue its Charity pull-tab ticket product line.

It said it remains committed to its Lottery customers and will continue to offer this product line through its own production capability while continuing talks with interested parties for the future supply of Lottery pull-tab tickets.
It said it will write-off about $2.4 million, of which $2 million is non-cash from the disposition of the assets related to these product lines.
Scientific Games said it believes it will achieve higher returns on its invested capital from its other product lines.
The company also announced that it has been awarded a five-year extension by the Georgia Lottery Corporation beginning June 1998 for its current Co-Operative Services contract.
